recognize_zh: 兩格末梢血中的淋巴樣細胞核染色質成塊，核輪廓不規則，有小的核芽（nuclear budding）突出，旁邊還有與主核分離的小圓形核碎片（micronucleus），細胞質少、淡藍；背景紅血球與血小板大致正常。在單株 B 細胞淋巴球增多症（MBL）的追蹤抹片上，這種核出芽變化值得注意。
features: Small to intermediate lymphoid cells with scant pale blue cytoplasm and clumped chromatin
Irregular nuclear contours with small nuclear buds/protrusions
Small detached round nuclear fragments adjacent to the main nucleus (micronucleus-like), left panel
Adjacent normal-appearing small mature lymphocyte with dense chromatin for comparison (left panel)
Background red cells largely normocytic; platelets present; no smudge cells in these fields
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered small to intermediate lymphoid cells with scant pale cytoplasm, coarsely clumped chromatin and irregular nuclear outlines with small nuclear buds. In the left field a small round nuclear fragment lies adjacent to the lymphoid cell, resembling a micronucleus, next to an unremarkable small mature lymphocyte. Red cells and platelets show no significant abnormality in these fields. In a patient with a known monoclonal B-cell lymphocytosis, these nuclear budding changes are noted descriptively; they are not specific and require correlation with flow cytometry and clinical follow-up.

ddx.vs: CLL has a similar CD5+/CD23+ phenotype, so separation from MBL rests on an absolute monoclonal B-cell count ≥5 x10^9/L or tissue/cytopenic disease rather than on nuclear morphology.
ATLL cells show multilobated, clover-leaf nuclei with deep indentations and a CD4+/CD25+ T-cell phenotype, not small buds with separate fragments on B cells.
Sézary cells have cerebriform, finely grooved nuclei rather than discrete nuclear buds and micronuclei.

ddx.dx: Apoptotic lymphocytes or drug/radiation-induced nuclear damage
ddx.vs: Apoptotic cells have condensed, fragmented dense chromatin balls with eosinophilic cytoplasm, and genotoxic injury is suggested by clinical exposure history.
